email_body:
Dear Replika team,

I'm applying for the Technical SEO & GEO Specialist role. Your mission to build AI that cares, not just thinks, resonates deeply. I want to help more people discover Replika through search and AI answers.

My background combines technical SEO, GEO, and hands-on web development. At mirook.com, I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative audits that measurably improved search health. I've also built and optimized WordPress sites for clients, handling everything from schema to content. I use AI tools daily for research and automation, and I've published an Android app on Google Play, so I understand the store ecosystem.

I'm comfortable with Search Console, Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs, and I build my own reports. I'm eager to own organic growth across web, app stores, and AI answers, and to ship changes myself.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Replika's next chapter.

cover_letter:
Dear Replika team,

I'm writing to apply for the Technical SEO & GEO Specialist position. Replika's mission to build AI that cares, not just thinks, is exactly the kind of product I want to help grow. The opportunity to own organic strategy across web, app stores, and AI answers, and to do the hands-on work myself, is what I've been building toward.

My experience sits at the intersection of technical SEO, GEO, and web development. At mirook.com, I built and optimized a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical SEO and GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. That project taught me how structured data and entity optimization can influence both traditional and AI-powered search.

In my freelance work and at Episto, I've handled on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track results. I manage CMS content in WordPress and Shopify, and I've built sites from scratch, so I'm comfortable making changes in the codebase or CMS without waiting on an engineer. I also use AI tools daily for research, content, and audits, and I've published an Android app on Google Play, which gives me a practical understanding of the app store ecosystem.

I'm eager to bring this mix of technical skill and hands-on execution to Replika. I'd love to discuss how I can help grow organic revenue and make Replika the answer when someone asks for an AI companion.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
